Maya (CS): Week0 check-in for Galileo private/VPC onboard. Quick summary: networking & IAM smoke passed; two items blocking cutover: (1) audit logs missing sessionContext.identity.sessionIssuer, (2) KMS rotation automation error due to alias mismatch. Tagging @Ravi and @Noor.

Ravi (Platform): Can you drop a sanitized log line and the exact script error so I can reproduce?

Maya (CS): Log (redacted): 
- eventTime: 2026-04-05T11:03:12Z
- eventName: RunTask
- userIdentity: { type: AssumedRole, arn: arn:aws:sts::555555555555:assumed-role/GalileoCross/Runner }  // expected sessionIssuer missing

Script error: "KMS alias \"alias/galileo-prod-enc\" not found" 14 actual alias present: alias/galileo-prod-enc-2026.

Noor (Security): Sounds like two likely causes: CloudTrail deliverer configured without management events, or the log forwarder (Fluentd/Splunk) is dropping nested sessionIssuer fields. I'll validate CloudTrail settings and delivery-role trust.

OpsBot: smoke-suite: 19/21 checks passed; failures: kms:fail audit:fail. Artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/galileo/week0/1797778881

Ravi (Platform): I'll make the rotation script tolerant of suffixed aliases and add a verification step. Patch ETA: EOD. Also noted a temporary gateway rule allowing collector SNI; will revert after verification.

Noor (Security): I'll check delivery pipeline today and update the onboarding runbook to require includeManagementEvents=true and preservation of sessionIssuer/sessionContext fields if needed. Report by tomorrow 12:00 PT.

Maya (CS): Plan agreed. If both items open by Friday EOW we'll mark medium renewal risk and schedule a customer remediation call next week. 30m sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to review fixes.

Ravi (Platform): On calendar. I'll bring patch link and smoke logs.

Maya (CS): Thanks team 14 I'll DM Galileo ops with summary and ask for temporary read-only log access if required.
